description: Proves bad input is refused, that Report and Remove on a runner with no standalone Java report CLEAN and change nothing, that the UDF summary is written, and that a second run is harmless. GitHub's runner keeps its JDKs in a tool cache outside the vendor folders, so a CLEAN result also shows those are not treated as standalone installs. Real uninstalls, the keep list and shared cleanup are Tier 2 on an internal VM, because the Windows harness has no step to install Java first.

steps.label: A keep term under 3 characters is refused
Report on a runner with no standalone Java is clean
UDF summary written where the Datto agent reads it
steps.name: Custom250

steps.label: Remove with nothing to remove changes nothing
No uninstall log folder is left behind when nothing was uninstalled
Tier 2: on an internal VM with Oracle Java 8, Eclipse Temurin JDK 17 and Amazon Corretto 11 installed, Report lists all three and changes nothing
Tier 2: Remove with usrKeep Corretto uninstalls Oracle and Temurin, keeps Corretto, and leaves the JavaSoft key and PATH alone
Tier 2: Remove with no keep list uninstalls Corretto and cleans the shared leftovers
Tier 2: a JRE bundled inside an application folder on that VM is untouched
